basic_info.description: 1646 19th Avenue is a pride-of-ownership fourplex featuring four (4) spacious 1BD/1BA units; two front (west), two back each (east) each with dedicated 1-car SxS (tandem) garage parking (as leased now). Great investor opportunity in the heart of the Inner Sunset. Built in 1957 and offering approx. 3,400 sq. ft. per tax records, the building has been well-maintained and updated, including four renovated bathrooms, LVP flooring, and contemporary kitchen and all 4 renovated bathroom finishes. Each unit is separately metered for PG&E (gas & electric), minimizing owner expenses. Amenities include an owner-owned coin-op laundry, secure garage parking with storage cabinets, and a shared east-facing step-out patio and backyard. All units are on month-to-month leases, providing immediate income and long-term upside. Ideally located near Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, UCSF, and just one block from Irving Street offering top-rated restaurants, cafes, and retail. Excellent access to MUNI bus lines and the N-Judah light rail. A rare, well-positioned multi-family asset with immediate income with upside, flexibility, and location appeal. Don't miss this opportunity to add it to your portfolio.
